date.description: Bar session date in YYYY-MM-DD format

start.description: an intraday bar only: its opening instant (UTC); absent on a daily bar

volume.description: Reported volume. Null for FX pairs, which have no traded volume.

status.description: Revision status, separate from an exchange settlement price. `settled` means the bar is no longer expected to change: a security session confirmed final, a crypto UTC day confirmed unchanged, or an FX, futures, or index session past `revision_window`. `unsettled` means revisions remain possible or the close is missing

session_complete.description: Whether the session has closed under `freshness.session_calendar`: futures use their CME product schedule (16:00 Chicago, grains 13:20, livestock 13:05), indices and yields use 16:15 New York, and FX uses 23:59 London. History includes completed sessions only. An unfinished session appears in the quote; a completed session awaiting its bar appears in `freshness.pending`. Settlement status is separate

complete.description: Whether every requested session is accounted for: served as a bar (a bar with no values included) or named in `missing`. False with `complete_reason`; null when the expected sessions are not known. Each bar's own `field_states` say which values carry a limit

complete_reason.description: `insufficient_history`: the request reaches before the history held; ask a shorter period or a later `end`. `temporarily_unavailable`: a completed session has no bar yet (`freshness.pending` names it). `possibly_incomplete`: crypto days may be missing. Null when `complete` is true or null

missing.description: Requested sessions not served whole, each a `calendar_day`: FX, futures, and index sessions with no available bar, or only a provisional bar (`provisional`); intraday sessions holding fewer bars than their trading hours imply (with `bars` and `bars_expected`); intraday sessions that cannot be put on the served adjustment basis

window_bound.description: Window restriction: `history_depth` means available history begins at `from`, or at `history_from` for intraday bars; these differ when the earliest sessions appear in `missing`. `calendar` means calendar coverage limits the window. Null when unrestricted

history_from.description: Earliest available session for the instrument and, for intraday bars, interval; for crypto, the first covered UTC day. Requests extending earlier stop here, identified by `window_bound: history_depth` or intraday `complete_reason`. Paging with `continue_end` ends at this boundary

continue_end.description: `end` for the next older window; keep `interval`, `limit` and `start`. Null when the window reaches `start` or `history_from`

through.description: the newest session held for the instrument

pending.description: the newest completed session whose bar is due but not yet available; `stale` says whether it is overdue

settled_through.description: the newest session whose bar is final; null when no session's bar is final yet, with the reason in `field_states`, and a plain null when it is not assessed for this window

session_calendar.description: an FX, futures, or index bar window: the calendar that defines its sessions; null for every other family
